ITEM PARAGRAPHS
You
will
find
that
most
parents
focus
heavily
on
formal
teaching
instead
of
natural
learning
when
helping
their
children
acquire
a
new
language
.
Of
course
,
you
don't
actually
have
to
know
how
to
teach
baby
languages
to
be
an
effective
guide
for
your
child
.
But
,
if
you
know
how
to
embrace
the
role
of
a
co-learner
,
the
entire
process
of
learning
will
be
more
enjoyable
for
both
you
and
your
infant
.
Another
way
to
approach
this
is
to
treat
the
new
tongue
as
a
first
language
from
birth
,
allowing
the
child
to
absorb
it
through
daily
immersion
.
